specs.description: Stellar Jackpots-Dolphin Gold is a 4x5 reel, 40-line underwater-themed slot featuring Free Games with stacked Gold Dolphin wilds and a multi-level Stellar Jackpots bonus where players advance through challenge levels to win fixed Mini, Minor, or Major jackpots.

functional_symbols.name: Blue Dolphin
functional_symbols.description: Wild symbol that substitutes for all symbols and doubles all substituted wins. Appears on reels 2, 3, and 4 only. Also triggers Free Games.

functional_symbols.name: Gold Dolphin
functional_symbols.description: Wild symbol that substitutes for all symbols except Blue Dolphin. Appears on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5 in Free Games only as stacked wilds.

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Triggered by 3 or more Scatter symbols, awards 10 Free Games. During Free Games, low-paying symbols (A, K, Q, J, 10, 9) are removed from the reels.

features.name: Symbol Removal
features.context: Free Games section describing symbol changes
features.description: During Free Games, the low-paying symbols 'A', 'K', 'Q', 'J', '10' and '9' are not present on the reels, leaving only premium symbols.

features.name: Pick Bonus
features.description: Randomly triggered by any Wild symbol in base game or Free Games. Player selects from 12 coins to reveal bonus babies until 3 matching types are found to win the corresponding jackpot.

features.name: Static Jackpot
features.context: Jinfu Feature section describing prize tiers
features.description: Four fixed jackpot tiers (MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, GRAND) awarded through the Jinfu Feature pick bonus mechanism.

specs.description: Jinfu Xingyun is a 5-reel, 3-row Asian-themed slot with 243 ways to win. The game features Free Games where low-paying symbols are removed, and the Jinfu Feature pick bonus that awards four-tier static jackpots triggered randomly by Wild symbols.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Scatter, appears on reels 2, 3, and 4 only, can randomly trigger Jinfu Feature

functional_symbols.name: Scatter
functional_symbols.description: 3 or more trigger Free Games, scatter wins multiplied by total bet

features.name: Cash On Reels
features.context: WHITE WHALE section describing credit prizes on symbols
features.description: White Whale symbols on reels 3, 4, and 5 display credit prizes (150-250x on reel 3, 300-500x on reel 4, 1000-10000x on reel 5) that are awarded in addition to ways wins when the symbol is part of a winning combination.
characteristics: Awards in addition to ways wins

features.name: Pick Bonus
features.context: PROGRESSIVE PICK BONUS section describing picking from 21 ships
features.description: Players pick from 21 ships to reveal progressive or White Whale symbols. Match 3 progressive symbols to win that jackpot. White Whale symbols remove progressive tiers from the field.
characteristics: White Whale symbols eliminate progressive tiers

features.name: Progressive Jackpot
features.operator_name: Progressive Pick Bonus and Wicked Wheel Bonus
features.context: Multiple sections describing progressive tiers funded by percentage of wagers
features.description: Progressive jackpots with Mini, Minor, Major, and Grand tiers that can be won through either the Progressive Pick Bonus or Wicked Wheel Bonus. Progressives are funded by a percentage of all wagers.

features.name: Wheel
features.context: Section describing wheel with credit slices and progressive slices
features.description: Triggered by 3 Wicked Wheel symbols on reels 3, 4, and 5. The wheel contains credit slices (5-375x total bet) and three progressive slices. White Whale applies up to 12 multipliers to credit slices before the wheel spins.

features.name: Nudges
features.context: Wicked Wheel Bonus section describing White Whale nudging wheel to adjacent slices
features.description: After landing on a credit slice in the Wicked Wheel Bonus, White Whale may randomly nudge the wheel to an adjacent increased credit or increased credit with multiplier slice.
characteristics: Random nudge to adjacent higher value

specs.description: Wicked Wheel Moby Dick is an underwater adventure slot featuring White Whale symbols with credit prizes, a progressive pick bonus where players choose from 21 ships, and the signature Wicked Wheel bonus with multipliers and nudge features. The game offers multiple ways to win progressive jackpots through both pick and wheel mechanics.

functional_symbols.name: White Whale
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Wicked Wheel, displays credit prizes on reels 3-5, awards prizes in addition to ways wins

functional_symbols.name: Wicked Wheel
functional_symbols.description: 3 scattered on reels 3, 4, and 5 triggers the Wicked Wheel Bonus

features.name: Hold and Spin
features.description: Triggered by 6+ Bonus symbols, locks triggering symbols and awards 3 respins. Additional Bonus symbols reset respins to 3 and stay locked.
characteristics: Snake symbols move and add Golden Coins

features.name: Static Jackpot
features.context: Hold the Jackpot Bonus section and paytable references
features.description: Fixed jackpot tiers (MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, GRAND) awarded through special symbols during Hold the Jackpot Bonus. GRAND awarded when all 40 reels filled.
characteristics: Multiple jackpots of same type possible
GRAND cancels other prizes when won

features.name: Cascading Reels
features.context: Main rules section describing winning symbol removal
features.description: After wins, winning symbols disappear and new symbols fall to create additional winning combinations.
characteristics: Continues until no new wins form

features.name: Colossal Symbols
features.description: Symbols can appear as 2x2 or 3x3 blocks covering multiple positions. Only visible portions count for wins.
characteristics: all symbols except Bonus can be Mega

features.name: Respin
features.context: Main rules section describing 3-5 Bonus symbol trigger
features.description: Landing 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols triggers a paid re-spin with Bonus symbols held, increasing chances of activating Hold the Jackpot.

features.name: Cash On Reels
features.context: Rules section describing Bonus symbol prizes
features.description: Bonus symbols display prize values ranging from x1-x5 player's bet. Prizes paid during Hold the Jackpot Bonus.

features.name: Gamble Feature
features.description: Allows players to risk wins by selecting symbols to double winnings. Seven rounds available with option to collect after each round.

features.name: Buy Bonus
features.description: Shop button allows purchasing available bonuses in the game.

specs.description: An 8x8 grid slot with 16,777,216 ways to win featuring cascading reels, mega symbols, and a complex Hold the Jackpot bonus with 40 independent reels across upper and lower sections.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Bonus symbols

functional_symbols.name: Bonus
functional_symbols.description: Awards prizes x1-x5 bet, triggers respins with 3-5 symbols, activates Hold the Jackpot with 6+ symbols

functional_symbols.name: Snake
functional_symbols.description: Moves toward highest Golden Coin value, adds Golden Coins with 1x multiplier, doubles values when passing through occupied positions

functional_symbols.name: Silver Coin
functional_symbols.description: Accumulates values from Golden and Silver Coins below it, multiplies by 1-5x randomly

functional_symbols.name: Mystery
functional_symbols.description: Transforms into any other Bonus symbol, reveals at end of Hold the Jackpot bonus

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Landing 3, 4 or 5 FREE SPINS scatters triggers 5, 8 or 12 FREE SPINS respectively. During Free Spins, either YOUNG DRAGON, DRAGON QUEEN or DRAGON KING will land on the middle reel on each spin.
characteristics: guaranteed dragon wilds on middle reel

features.name: Expanding Wilds
features.operator_name: YOUNG DRAGON, DRAGON QUEEN, DRAGON KING
features.context: H3 sections YOUNG DRAGON, DRAGON QUEEN, DRAGON KING
features.description: YOUNG DRAGON and DRAGON QUEEN expand over the whole reel if they can form part of winning combination when expanded. DRAGON KING always expands and mirrors reels.

features.name: Multiplier Wild
features.operator_name: BABY DRAGON, DRAGON QUEEN WIN MULTIPLIER
features.context: H3 sections BABY DRAGON, DRAGON QUEEN
features.description: BABY DRAGON and DRAGON QUEEN wilds carry x3 WIN MULTIPLIER. Multiple multiplier wilds multiply together (e.g., x3 * x3 = x9).

features.name: Persistence
features.context: H3 section DRAGON PROGRESS and Game Progress section
features.description: The game has 4 levels of progress that fill by landing specific DRAGON WILD symbols. Progress is saved forever at each stake level and unlocks new wild types.

features.name: Progressive Jackpot
features.context: H3 sections Jackpot Game, Progressive Jackpot, Time Jackpot
features.description: Features both progressive and time jackpots that grow from player contributions. Time jackpot guaranteed to pay before set date with increasing odds.

specs.description: Dragons Mirror is a 5x3 fantasy slot featuring a unique 4-level dragon progression system that unlocks increasingly powerful wild types. The game includes expanding wilds with multipliers, free spins with guaranteed dragon wilds, and both progressive and time-based jackpots.

functional_symbols.name: DRAGON EGG WILD
functional_symbols.description: Basic wild symbol that contributes to Level 1 progress

functional_symbols.name: BABY DRAGON WILD
functional_symbols.description: Wild with x3 multiplier, appears on reels 2 and 4, unlocked at Level 2

functional_symbols.name: YOUNG DRAGON WILD
functional_symbols.description: Expanding wild that covers whole reel if it forms winning combinations, appears on reels 2-4

functional_symbols.name: DRAGON QUEEN WILD
functional_symbols.description: Expanding wild with x3 multiplier, appears only on middle reel, unlocked at Level 3

functional_symbols.name: DRAGON KING WILD
functional_symbols.description: Expanding wild that mirrors reels 1-2 onto reels 4-5, appears only on middle reel, unlocked at Level 4

functional_symbols.name: FREE SPINS SCATTER
functional_symbols.description: Triggers 5-12 free spins when 3-5 land anywhere on the reels

features.description: Players are awarded picks of green bills that award credits and colored bills (red, yellow, purple). Each pick reveals individual prizes, making this a true pick bonus where picking is the main mechanic.

features.context: H2 section 'BONUS SCATTERS' and 'DURING THE BONUS WHEEL FEATURE'
features.description: Red bills collected during Money Catch Bonus trigger Bonus Wheel spins that award fixed Jackpot Awards. The game mentions specific Jackpot Awards available through the wheel feature.

features.name: Wheel
features.context: H2 section 'DURING THE BONUS WHEEL FEATURE'
features.description: For each Bonus Wheel spin earned, players spin the Bonus Wheel to win Jackpot Awards. This is a standalone wheel bonus triggered by collecting red bills.

The game includes Extended, Jackpots, and Mystery features that enhance the pick bonus with additional awards, wheel spins for jackpots, and multiplied mystery prizes.

functional_symbols.name: Bonus Scatter
functional_symbols.description: Triggers Money Catch Bonus and activates corresponding Bonus Features (Jackpot/Red Bills, Extended/Purple Bills, Mystery/Yellow Bills)
